title: Continuous almost everywhere equal functions agree pointwise on an open set
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$, let $U\subseteq\mathbf R^m$ be open, and let $f,g:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf C$ be continuous on $U$. If $f=g$ Lebesgue almost everywhere on $U$ (outside a set of Lebesgue measure zero in $U$), then $f(x)=g(x)$ for every $x\in U$.
